title: Cut live registers to lift modeled occupancy past 75% (CUDA)
info: registers-per-thread is a static count of distinct local-variable declarations in your kernel body, walked from the real parsed AST
occupancy model: blocks_by_regs = 2048 // (regs_per_thread * 128), occupancy = min(blocks_by_regs, 8) / 8, target 0.75
